# Mesrai Documentation

> Documentation for Mesrai, a multi-agent AI code review platform. Mesrai reads your repository as a graph (AST parsing + semantic chunking), not just the diff, and reviews every pull request for bugs, security risks, performance issues, architecture impact and your team's own rules. It works with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket and Azure DevOps. Mesrai is BYOK: you bring your own LLM key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, AWS Bedrock or any OpenAI-compatible provider). Plans: a 14-day free trial with every feature, then Pro at ₹499 / $6 per developer per month, or Enterprise (self-hosted, SSO, Indian data residency).

## Getting started
- [Overview](https://docs.mesrai.com/guides/overview): what Mesrai is and how it works
- [Quickstart](https://docs.mesrai.com/guides/quickstart): connect a repository and get your first review
- [Pricing and plans](https://docs.mesrai.com/guides/pricing)
- [Bring your own key (BYOK)](https://docs.mesrai.com/guides/byok): supported LLM providers and setup
